profile.name: Haval Jalal
profile.tagline: I am looking for a junior developer role, preferably .NET and React, in Gothenburg or remote. CV, LinkedIn and e-mail are right here, and I usually reply the same day.
profile.availability: Looking for a junior developer role · Gothenburg or remote
profile.intro: Fifteen years at Volvo Cars, ten of them as a team leader on the assembly floor. Now a .NET and React developer building production-ready applications from database to UI, looking for a junior role where I get to do that full time.
profile.about: I've worked on the production floor, led teams and seen what works when you change how people work. I bring that experience into my code: I build applications end-to-end, from database design and secure .NET APIs to React interfaces and cloud deployment, with a focus on clean architecture, security, validation and delivery.

projects.title: CarCheck
projects.summary:
Enter a registration number, or photograph the plate with your phone, and get buy, wait or avoid with a 0–100 score that weighs twelve factors: inspection, mileage, debts, insurance, recalls and more.

Built alone from idea to launch: a .NET backend with Clean Architecture, a React frontend, accounts, payments through Stripe and GDPR with all data kept in the EU.
projects.tagline: A data-driven recommendation before you buy a used car.
highlights: Search by plate, photograph it, or paste a Blocket listing
GDPR: export or delete all your data, database hosted in the EU
projects.role: Everything: idea, backend, frontend, payments and operations

projects.title: PreSync
projects.summary:
Reads your calendar and compiles a short briefing on every person you are about to meet, built from public information. Records and transcribes meetings so they become searchable, and gives managers an overview of the team's meetings.

MVP built by a team of three at InFiNet Code. I built the frontend and the backend.
projects.tagline: Walk into every meeting knowing who is across the table.
projects.role: Frontend and backend in a team of three

projects.title: Dojo Future
projects.summary:
School system from InFiNet Code for Swedish schools: admissions, attendance, grades, timetables, internships and finance in one system, with reporting to MYH and CSN built in. Separate portals for administration, teachers, students and internship companies.

I built, debugged and made the system ready to sell together with the team.
projects.tagline: One platform for the whole school, module by module.
highlights: MYH and CSN reporting with automatic exports
Five portals, one for every role at the school
projects.role: Development, debugging and making it ready to sell, together with the team

projects.title: Eventify
projects.summary: A .NET console app where the SQL Server database is the source of truth: tables, constraints, views and security were written in T-SQL first, then the EF Core models were scaffolded from the database. Handles customers, events, orders and tickets, and produces reports such as top customers and sales per event.
projects.tagline: A ticketing system built database first.
highlights: Eight T-SQL scripts from schema to cleanup
EF Core models scaffolded from the database

projects.title: JobApplicationTracker
projects.summary: One of my first C# apps: add applications, update status, delete, and list everything sorted by date with days since applying. The assignment where LINQ went from baffling to the thing I reach for first.
projects.tagline: Keep track of job applications from the terminal.
highlights: CRUD with status Applied, Interview, Offer and Rejected
Counts days since applying and response dates

projects.title: MiniECommerceDB
projects.summary: Database project for a small e-commerce shop: customers, products, categories, inventory, orders, order lines and payments. The ER model was designed first, then everything was written in T-SQL: schema with constraints, seed data, CRUD, joins, views and stored procedures for reports.
projects.tagline: A relational database in 3NF with views and stored procedures.
highlights: Seven entities and one junction table
Normalised to 3NF with PK, FK, UNIQUE and CHECK
Views and stored procedures for reports

journey.title: Studying, leading and building at once
journey.text: Second year of the .NET developer programme, team leader at Volvo Cars at 75 % and junior software engineer at InFiNet Code part time. In spring 2027 I do my second internship in the platform team at Volvo Cars. Looking for a junior developer role, preferably .NET and React.
bullets: Junior software engineer at InFiNet Code, part time
Second internship in the platform team at Volvo Cars, February to May 2027

journey.title: Internship 1: developer in a platform team
journey.text: Ten weeks as a developer in a team building apps for production. Four stories through the whole stack in Angular and Java, my own pull requests, code review and pipelines in Azure DevOps. Presented my changes at a release meeting and was invited back for the second internship.
bullets: Angular and TypeScript in the frontend
Java and Spring in the backend
Azure DevOps pipelines and code review
Invited back to the same team

journey.title: Junior software engineer & project lead
journey.text: Building websites, apps and automation for small businesses, from the first client meeting to launch. Leading the projects and delivering both frontend and backend.
bullets: Client sites and demos for small businesses
PreSync and Dojo Future together with the team
Project management: planning, follow-up and delivery

journey.title: From machines to software
journey.text: Started studying to become a .NET developer alongside the job. A two-year vocational programme with fullstack, Clean Architecture, SQL and cloud. What began as a fascination with automation and digital systems became a career change.

journey.title: Team leader, production & quality
journey.text: Leading a production team since 2014, at 75 % alongside the studies since autumn 2025. Structuring work, motivating people and delivering under pressure is everyday life here, and exactly what a development team needs too.
bullets: Leading a production team with focus on quality, safety and delivery
Coaching, training and developing team members
Process optimisation and streamlining of workflows

journey.title: Assembler on the production line
journey.text: Started on the line in Torslanda. Learned pace, quality and how a factory works when everything has to be right every minute.
